scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the hero section displays correctly with MirDB logo, tagline, subtitle, and call-to-action buttons

steps.description: Navigate to the MirDB homepage URL
steps.context: User discovers MirDB through search or referral

steps.description: Check that logo, tagline, subtitle, and CTA buttons are visible and properly styled
steps.context: Hero section should be the first visible element above the fold

test_cases.input: Load homepage and inspect hero section
test_cases.expected: MirDB logo (logo.gif) is prominently displayed
Tagline reads 'A Persistent Key-Value Store with Memcached Protocol'
Subtitle emphasizes 'Built in Rust for speed and reliability'
Get Started button is visible and links to quick start section
View on GitHub button is visible and links to https://github.com/yetone/mirdb

scenarios.name: Key Features Section
scenarios.description: Verify the key features section displays all six core capabilities of MirDB

steps.description: Navigate to the key features section of the homepage
steps.context: User wants to understand MirDB capabilities

steps.action: Verify all feature cards are displayed
steps.description: Check that all six key features are presented with descriptions
steps.context: Features should be clearly visible and informative

test_cases.expected: Feature card displays 'Memcached Protocol' with description about drop-in replacement
Feature card displays 'Persistent Storage' with LSM-tree durability description
Feature card displays 'High Performance' with skip list memtables description
Feature card displays 'Automatic Compaction' with minor and major compaction support
Feature card displays 'Configurable' with TOML-based configuration description
Feature card displays 'Async I/O' with Tokio networking description

scenarios.name: Usage Demonstration Section
scenarios.description: Verify the animated usage demonstration (usage.gif) is displayed correctly with proper caption

steps.description: Scroll to the section showing the usage GIF
steps.context: User wants to see MirDB in action

steps.description: Check that usage.gif is displayed with explanatory caption
steps.context: Demonstration should clearly show terminal interaction

test_cases.expected: usage.gif is displayed in the demonstration section
Caption text explains what the demonstration shows
GIF uses lazy loading attribute to defer loading until visible
GIF has descriptive alt text for screen readers

scenarios.name: Quick Start Installation Section
scenarios.description: Verify the quick start section displays installation commands with copy functionality

steps.description: Scroll to or click 'Get Started' to reach quick start section
steps.context: User wants to install MirDB

steps.description: Check that clone, build, and run commands are displayed
steps.context: Commands should be easy to read and copy

steps.description: Click copy button and verify command is copied to clipboard
steps.context: User should be able to copy commands with one click

test_cases.expected: Displays 'git clone https://github.com/yetone/mirdb'
Displays 'cd mirdb && cargo build --release'
Displays './target/release/mirdb-server -c etc/mirdb.toml'

test_cases.input: Click copy button for installation command
test_cases.expected: Command text is copied to clipboard successfully
Copy button shows visual confirmation (icon change or tooltip) on success

scenarios.name: Operations Examples Section
scenarios.description: Verify code examples for basic Memcached operations (get, set, delete) are displayed

steps.description: Scroll to the section showing Memcached operation examples
steps.context: User wants to understand how to interact with MirDB

steps.description: Check that set, get, and delete examples are shown with proper syntax
steps.context: Examples should match Memcached protocol format

test_cases.expected: Shows 'set mykey 0 3600 5' followed by 'hello'
Shows 'get mykey' command
Shows 'delete mykey' command
Code examples have proper syntax highlighting for readability

scenarios.name: GitHub Navigation Link
scenarios.description: Verify GitHub repository link is prominent and functional

steps.description: Find GitHub link in hero section and/or navigation
steps.context: GitHub link should be easily discoverable

steps.description: Click the link and verify it navigates to correct repository
steps.context: User wants to view source code or contribute

test_cases.input: Click 'View on GitHub' button in hero section
test_cases.expected: Navigates to https://github.com/yetone/mirdb

test_cases.input: Verify GitHub link opens in new tab
test_cases.expected: Link has target='_blank' and rel='noopener noreferrer' attributes
GitHub link is visible without scrolling (above the fold)

scenarios.name: Project Status and CI Badge
scenarios.description: Verify project status and CircleCI build badge are displayed

steps.description: Find the CircleCI build status badge on the page
steps.context: Build status provides credibility indicator

steps.description: Check badge displays correct status and links to CI
steps.context: Users may want to verify build health

test_cases.expected: CircleCI build status badge is visible on the page
Badge links to CircleCI build page for the project
Badge image has descriptive alt text indicating build status

scenarios.name: Feature Roadmap Section
scenarios.description: Verify roadmap displays completed features and planned items

steps.description: Scroll to the roadmap section of the homepage
steps.context: User wants to understand project direction and maturity

steps.description: Check that completed features are marked and planned features are listed
steps.context: Roadmap provides project transparency

test_cases.expected: Shows completed: Tokio with memcached protocol, memtable with skiplist, minor compaction, major compaction
Shows planned: Raft consensus support
Completed items are visually distinguished from planned items (checkmarks, colors, etc.)

scenarios.name: Footer Section
scenarios.description: Verify footer contains author attribution, GitHub link, and CI badge

steps.description: Navigate to the bottom of the page to view footer
steps.context: Footer provides additional navigation and attribution

steps.description: Check author name, email, and links are present
steps.context: Attribution and contact information

test_cases.expected: Footer displays author: yetone
Footer displays or links to yetoneful@gmail.com
Footer contains link to GitHub repository
Footer contains CircleCI build status badge

scenarios.name: Responsive Design - Mobile
scenarios.description: Verify homepage renders correctly on mobile devices

steps.description: Set viewport to mobile dimensions (375px width)
steps.context: Testing mobile responsiveness per NFR-2

steps.description: Check that all content is readable and interactive on mobile
steps.context: No horizontal scrolling, proper touch targets

test_cases.expected: All content fits within viewport without horizontal scrolling
Hero section stacks vertically with readable text and accessible CTAs
Feature cards stack vertically in single column layout
All buttons and links have minimum 44x44px touch target
Code blocks are scrollable horizontally if needed, text is readable

scenarios.name: Responsive Design - Tablet
scenarios.description: Verify homepage renders correctly on tablet devices

steps.description: Set viewport to tablet dimensions (768px width)
steps.context: Testing tablet responsiveness per NFR-2

steps.description: Check that layout appropriately uses available space
steps.context: Optimal use of tablet screen real estate

test_cases.expected: Layout adapts to two-column grid where appropriate
Features display in 2-column or 3-column grid layout
Usage GIF scales appropriately for tablet viewport

scenarios.name: Responsive Design - Desktop
scenarios.description: Verify homepage renders correctly on desktop displays

steps.description: Set viewport to desktop dimensions (1440px width)
steps.context: Testing desktop display per NFR-2

steps.description: Check that all sections display optimally on large screens
steps.context: Proper use of desktop space without excessive stretching

test_cases.expected: Content has appropriate max-width to prevent excessive line lengths
Features display in multi-column grid (3 or 6 columns)
Hero and demo sections may use side-by-side layout where appropriate

scenarios.name: Accessibility - Keyboard Navigation
scenarios.description: Verify all interactive elements are accessible via keyboard

steps.description: Use Tab to navigate through all interactive elements
steps.context: Accessibility requirement per NFR-3

steps.description: Verify buttons and links can be activated with keyboard
steps.context: Complete keyboard operability

test_cases.expected: All buttons, links, and interactive elements receive focus in logical order
Focus indicator is clearly visible on all focusable elements

test_cases.input: Activate CTA buttons with Enter key
test_cases.expected: Buttons activate correctly when Enter is pressed
Skip to main content link is available for screen reader users

scenarios.name: Accessibility - Color Contrast
scenarios.description: Verify text meets WCAG 2.1 AA color contrast requirements

steps.description: Check all text against background colors for contrast ratio
steps.context: WCAG 2.1 AA requires 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text

test_cases.expected: Body text has minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio against background
Large heading text has minimum 3:1 contrast ratio
Links are distinguishable from surrounding text (color + underline)
Button text has sufficient contrast against button background

scenarios.name: Accessibility - Image Alt Text
scenarios.description: Verify all images have appropriate alt text

steps.description: Check that all img elements have descriptive alt attributes
steps.context: Screen reader users need alternative text for images

test_cases.expected: Logo has descriptive alt text like 'MirDB Logo'
Usage demo GIF has alt text describing the demonstration
CI badge has alt text indicating build status purpose

scenarios.name: Performance - Page Load Time
scenarios.description: Verify page loads within acceptable time limits

steps.description: Test page load time with 3G network throttling
steps.context: NFR-1 requires under 3 seconds on 3G

test_cases.expected: First Contentful Paint under 3 seconds
Lighthouse performance score above 80
Above-the-fold content renders without waiting for external CSS

scenarios.name: Performance - Image Optimization
scenarios.description: Verify images are optimized for web delivery

steps.description: Check that large images use lazy loading and modern formats
steps.context: Assets are ~8.5MB combined requiring optimization

test_cases.expected: usage.gif has loading='lazy' attribute
logo.gif uses appropriate loading strategy (lazy if below fold)
Modern image formats (WebP) provided with GIF fallbacks if applicable

scenarios.name: SEO - Meta Tags
scenarios.description: Verify SEO meta tags are properly configured

steps.description: Check for proper meta tags, title, and Open Graph tags
steps.context: NFR-4 requires SEO optimization

test_cases.expected: Title includes 'MirDB' and describes the product
Meta description accurately describes MirDB in under 160 characters
og:title, og:description, og:image tags are present
Canonical link element is present with correct URL

scenarios.name: SEO - Semantic HTML
scenarios.description: Verify proper semantic HTML structure

steps.description: Check for proper heading hierarchy and semantic elements
steps.context: Semantic HTML improves SEO and accessibility

test_cases.expected: Single h1 element, proper h2-h6 nesting without skipping levels
Uses header, main, footer, section, nav elements appropriately
ARIA landmark roles or semantic elements define page regions
